introduction_markdown: This paper has two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: answer all 15 questions in the spaces provided; the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: answer all four questions; each carries 15 marks. Show all steps in your working. Calculators are allowed.
enonce_intro_markdown: A household consumed 300 units of electricity where the first 220 units are billed at 50 FCFA per unit and the rest at 79 FCFA per unit.

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the number of units to be paid at 79 FCFA.
Calculate the total amount paid by this household, in FCFA. *[6 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
First 220 units: $220\times 50 = 11\,000$ FCFA.

Remaining 80 units: $80\times 79 = 6\,320$ FCFA.

Total: $11\,000 + 6\,320 = 17\,320$ FCFA.
